inputs.text: It's just what happens when these progressive outfits grab power—they foster corruption at every level and rip apart the moral foundations that hold society together. KT Rama Rao has exposed the Congress administration's outright graft and their refusal to halt illegal mining, with Raghava Constructions tied straight to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy. These insiders always shield one another while letting lawlessness chip away at social order, personal responsibility, and the national resources meant to sustain strong families and our cultural roots. What we need is decisive authority to enforce real accountability and sweep away this kind of elite rot.
